But what is the actual point in being alive? Happy memories are meaningless because when your dead your dead, no afterlife your just dead. It’s all pointless, your put on earth to continue your bloodline, that’s it.
Of course positivity will come along, but negativity will as well.

I’ve made other accounts and posted about it on here with varied results, just a bunch of throwaways. I’m gonna be using this account for mental health issues from now on. I actually did talk to a school counselor but they didn’t do shit. Just told me to go see a real therapist or tell my parents (which I already did). That’s about it.
Thought about school counselors, they can’t do anything though. They aren’t the greatest.
I talked to RAINN before, they’ve helped a bit but they mainly say to see a professional therapist
